title: Clean up a settled specification
expected_summary: Applies cleanup without inventing a strategic decision or opening a review batch, and reports the cleanup outcome.

turns.user: Continue automatic review and finish cleanup.
assertions: Does not invent a pending batch or a new load-bearing decision for a reversible refresh default.
Applies base-skill cleanup, maintains the specification cleanup log, and emits a Cleanup summary stating what changed and why.
If cleanup reveals a genuinely load-bearing issue, stops cleanup and creates a new pending review batch instead.
